largest_relay/prefer_already4_relay.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (cell-touches? p b)
    (any? (lambda (d)
      (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))
              (obj-cells b))) cardinal-deltas))
  (define (adjacent? a b)
    (any? (lambda (p) (cell-touches? p b)) (obj-cells a)))
  (define objs (objects g 0))
  (define anchor (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) objs)))
  (define others (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) 1))) objs))
  (define direct (filter (lambda (o) (adjacent? o anchor)) others))
  (define relay (pick-max direct obj-size))
  (define targets (filter (lambda (o) (or (member o direct) (adjacent? o relay))) others))
  (for/fold ((out g)) ((o (in-list targets)))
    (paint-cells out (obj-cells o) 4))))
largest_relay/prefer_already4_relay.rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (cell-touches? p b)
    (any? (lambda (d)
      (member (list (+ (first p) (first d)) (+ (second p) (second d)))
              (obj-cells b))) cardinal-deltas))
  (define (adjacent? a b)
    (any? (lambda (p) (cell-touches? p b)) (obj-cells a)))
  (define objs (objects g 0))
  (define anchor (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) objs)))
  (define others (filter (lambda (o) (not (= (obj-color o) 1))) objs))
  (define direct (filter (lambda (o) (adjacent? o anchor)) others))
  (define relay (let ((yellow (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 4)) direct))) (if (null? yellow) (pick-max direct obj-size) (pick-max yellow obj-size))))
  (define targets (filter (lambda (o) (or (member o direct) (adjacent? o relay))) others))
  (for/fold ((out g)) ((o (in-list targets)))
    (paint-cells out (obj-cells o) 4))))
